query:
INSERT INTO publicchannels (id, deleteat, teamid, displayname, name, header, purpose)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
           SET deleteat    = $2,
               teamid      = $3,
               displayname = $4,
               name        = $5,
               header      = $6,
               purpose     = $7
